name: animated-text
title: Animated Text
description: Replaces changed display text while retaining one current native string.

upstream.reason: Cadence standalone changed-text primitive; no upstream shadcn equivalent.

motionProfile.reason: Only changed safe display-text runs receive bounded replacement effects; unchanged native text survives.

text.change/changed-runs.reason: Animated Text integrates changed display-text runs at its own parts, using the reached installed executor.
